description: Residential or mobile proxy coverage of AeonProxy. Without country it lists the countries served (narrow it with query, e.g. "japan"). With a country code it lists that country's regions, cities and ISPs (residential) or mobile carriers, each with the key that targets it in the proxy login (e.g. -cc-us-city-newyork). generate_proxy_lines and fetch_via_proxy accept exactly these values. Works without signing in.

country.description: two-letter country code (us, gb, jp); leave out to list countries

product.description: residential (home IPs) or mobile (4G/5G carrier IPs)

query.description: part of a country, region, city, ISP or carrier name, e.g. "bavaria", "osaka", "vodafone"

name: list_proxy_locations
title: List proxy locations
